annotations.title: Get the best time to ride

description: Use this when a visitor asks when to ride something to avoid long waits on a specific day within the next 30 days. Resolve the ride ID first. Returns hourly predicted waits with bounds, the typical wait by hour for that weekday, and the best and worst windows in park-local time; these are estimates, not guarantees.

date.description: Park-local date, YYYY-MM-DD, up to 30 days ahead; defaults to today.

ride_id.description: Canonical Parky ride ID from parky_find_experience.

name: parky_get_best_time
